name: carloop
description: CarLoop - plateforme de services automobiles avec 5 modules IA

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w server && npm run lint -w client
